programme_name: Master in Big Data and Business Intelligence

ects: 60 ECTS (RUCT breakdown 42 obligatorios + 6 prácticas + 12 TFM = 60; programme page states "60 ECTS")
modality: Presencial (Campus Arapiles, Madrid) — programme page states "Presencial"
language_of_instruction: "Español" (programme page factsheet: Modalidad: Presencial · Duración: 1 año · Idioma: Español · Créditos: 60 ECTS)
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND — UNIE publishes no tuition figure on the programme page, on its becas page, or anywhere on universidadunie.com; price is quoted only via the admissions adviser. Aggregator figures (e.g. educaweb "entre 7.000 y 8.000 euros") are NOT primary and are not recorded as fact.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — private university, sets its own single price; no separate non-EU tariff is published, but the page is silent rather than explicit, so this is NOT FOUND, not "no".
complementary_credits_required: RUCT (for the TITLE): NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — the Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos row is absent (null) for 4317892. Programme page (for the APPLICANT): complementos are offered/imposed where the prior degree lacks programming, mathematics or data-analysis content — "si tu formación no incluye conocimientos previos en programación, matemáticas o análisis de datos, puedes cursar complementos formativos". A 300-ECTS software engineering degree carries all three, so on the stated rule no complementos would apply, but UNIE publishes no ECTS count for them.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND for the 2027-28 intake. The programme page advertises only the current cohort start "OCT 2026" (2026-27) with "Plazas limitadas. Consulta disponibilidad". UNIE runs rolling admission (documentation to the Comisión de Admisión, then reserva de plaza) with no published open/close dates. 2027-28 dates are not out; no date has been shifted forward.
notes: Name mismatch worth flagging: UNIE now markets this title as "Máster Universitario en Ciencia de Datos e Inteligencia de Negocio" at /programas/master-universitario-big-data-business-intelligence, while the registered RUCT title is "Máster Universitario en Análisis de Datos Masivos e Inteligencia Empresarial / Master in Big Data and Business Intelligence". Same title, marketing name differs. RUCT code confirmed by exact university+title match in the register (Universidad Internacional de la Empresa), not from a fuzzy hint; the programme page does not print a código RUCT. The earlier URL /master-universitario-en-analisis-de-datos-masivos-big-data-e-inteligencia-empresarial-business-intelligence returns HTTP 404.

ects: 60 ECTS (RUCT breakdown 48 obligatorios + 6 prácticas + 6 TFM = 60; programme page states "60 ECTS")

non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — private university with a single published-nowhere price; no non-EU tariff is stated either way, so NOT FOUND rather than "no".
complementary_credits_required: RUCT (for the TITLE): 0 (RUCT) — Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0 for 3500236. Admission document (for the APPLICANT): complementos ARE imposed on this candidate's profile. UNIE's own "Perfil de ingreso" PDF states the master is aimed at ADE / Marketing / Negocios Internacionales / Analítica de Negocios / Economía graduates, and that other backgrounds "deberán cursar los complementos formativos establecidos en el apartado 3.1.3 ... Estos complementos formativos tendrán carácter obligatorio, y se realizarán antes del primer semestre del máster". The table assigns "Grados o licenciaturas del ámbito de la Ingeniería y Arquitectura ... sin formación previa en organizaciones de empresas dentro de su plan de estudios" → "Organización y Administración de empresas" (one complemento; Estadística is added only for "Otras áreas"). application_window_2027: NOT FOUND for the 2027-28 intake. Programme page advertises cohort starts "OCT 2026" (with an April 2026 calendar also referenced) — i.e. 2025-26/2026-27 intakes. Rolling admission via the Comisión de Admisión; no published open/close dates. 2027-28 not yet out; no date shifted forward.
notes: This is the ranked complementos finding for this slice: a 300-ECTS software engineering degree does NOT exempt the candidate here — engineering is explicitly listed as needing the business-organisation complemento, and the only exemption route is two years of documented business-analytics work experience. RUCT's 0 refers to the title, the PDF to the applicant; both recorded, per brief. RUCT code confirmed by exact university+title match ("por la Universidad Internacional de la Empresa") in the register; the programme page does not print a código RUCT.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería del Software: Cloud, Datos y Gestión de las Tecnologías de la Información
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 4316602, estado "Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)", Nivel MECES 3, verificado 06/06/2018, BOE 07/09/2018 y 12/08/2019 (plan de estudios BOE-A-2019-11895), Resolución Favorable para la Renovación de la Acreditación 22/07/2021
ects: 60 ECTS (us.es states "60.00"; structure 15 obligatorios + 33 optativos + 12 TFM, matching RUCT exactly)
modality: Presencial — taught at the Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería Informática, timetable "lunes a jueves de 18:00 a 21:00", with the option to spread it over two years
language_of_instruction: "Español" (us.es programme factsheet). Corroborated by the access requirement of "conocimiento del español en un nivel equivalente o superior al B2" for non-native speakers; English appears only as a 5% weighting in the selection criteria, not as a language of delivery.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 820.80 for the 60 ECTS at first enrolment (13,68 EUR/crédito x 60 = 820,80), plus separate administrative fees (secretaría, seguro escolar). Andalusian non-habilitante máster rate.
tuition_population: EU/resident AND non-EU — identical. Universidad de Sevilla states "los precios públicos son los mismos para todas las personas matriculadas en la Universidad de Sevilla", so the same 820,80 EUR applies to this non-EU candidate.
tuition_year_of_rates: 13,68 EUR/crédito is the figure published for 2025-26 under Decreto 98/2023 (as modified by Decreto 142/2025, applicable from curso 2025-26). Universidad de Sevilla's Centro de Atención a Estudiantes confirms the Decreto de Precios Públicos governs the current 2026-27 matrícula but publishes no separate 2026-27 amount; a distinct 2027-28 figure is not out.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — explicitly ruled out at this university. cat.us.es: "los precios públicos son los mismos para todas las personas matriculadas en la Universidad de Sevilla". Important context: Andalusia's Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2 DOES permit universities to vary the credit price up to 100% of the cost of the service, so the surcharge is legally available in this community — Sevilla simply has not exercised it. This is an explicit "no", not a silence.
complementary_credits_required: RUCT (for the TITLE): NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — the Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos row is absent (null) for 4316602. Programme admission page (for the APPLICANT): complementos of up to 18 ECTS may be required of applicants whose prior degree is not in the preferred group; the Distrito Único Andaluz ficha ranks access degrees by preferencia Alta/Media/Baja. A software engineering degree falls in the computing family this master is built on, so on the published rule complementos would not be expected — but the US pages do not state that in terms, so this is recorded as "up to 18 ECTS possible, decided at admission", not as zero.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND for 2027-28. Published 2026-27 Distrito Único Andaluz máster calendar (single application covering all Andalusian public universities, up to six choices): FASE 1, reserved for INTERNATIONAL applicants — applications 13-29 January 2026, adjudications 19 February, 12 March, 9 April 2026. FASE 2 (Spanish and international) — applications 17-26 June 2026, first adjudication 22 July, matrícula 23-27 July, second adjudication 14 September, resultas 29 Sept / 9, 20, 28 October 2026. FASE 3 — applications 8-15 September 2026. These are 2026-27 dates, stated as such; the 2027-28 calendar is not yet published and no date has been shifted forward.
notes: RUCT code 4316602 confirmed twice and independently: printed on the university's own programme page as "RUCT Code: 4316602", and matched exactly in the register by university+title. The Fase 1 international-only window in January is the operationally important item for a non-EU September-intake applicant: it opens roughly eight months before the intake and is the round that gives time for visa and equivalence checks. Access route for a non-EEES degree is by "comprobación por parte de la universidad del nivel de formación" with no homologación required.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ciencia de Datos
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 4316093, estado "Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)", Nivel MECES 3, verificado 20/07/2016, BOE 26/01/2017, 22/02/2017, 08/09/2021, 25/09/2023; Resolución Favorable para la Renovación de la Acreditación 26/03/2026 (and 18/05/2020)
ects: 90 ECTS over 2 cursos — UV ficha: "Créditos totales del título: 90 · Obligatorios: 65 · Prácticas externas 10 · Trabajo fin de máster: 15 · Cursos: 2". Matches RUCT exactly (65+10+15=90). 25 plazas ofertadas.
modality: "Modalidad de enseñanza: Presencial" (UV ficha) — Escola Tècnica Superior d'Enginyeria, Burjassot
language_of_instruction: "Lengua docencia: Castellano" — verbatim from the UV official ficha of the title (código titulación 2262). Single language; no English or Valencian group is listed.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 6,361.20 for the full 90 ECTS at first enrolment — 70,68 EUR/crédito x 90 = 6.361,20. (EU/resident comparison: 35,34 x 90 = 3.180,60 EUR.)
tuition_population: non-EU — this is the "estudiantado extranjero no UE ni régimen comunitario" price, which is the one that applies to a Tunisian citizen with no Spanish residency.
tuition_year_of_rates: Rates published by UV on its 2026/2027 matrícula pages; legal basis is Decreto 101/2024, de 2 de agosto, del Consell (Comunitat Valenciana), which fixes the tasas for university academic services. UV's ficha does not stamp a curso on the per-credit figure itself, so this is recorded as "the rate UV publishes for 2026-27"; a distinct 2027-28 figure is not out.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — exactly double, and automatic. The UV ficha prints two separate rows: "Precio del crédito primera matrícula: 35.34€" and "Precio del crédito primera matrícula para estudiantado extranjero no UE ni régimen comunitario: 70.68€". UV's matrícula page adds the operational rule verbatim: "A los estudiantes extranjeros no comunitarios que se matriculen en la UVEG, el sistema les considerará por defecto estudiantes no residentes y les aplicará los precios correspondientes. Una vez entregada la documentación que justifique su condición de residentes en España se procederá a reajustar sus pagos". So the surcharge is applied by default and can only be undone by proving Spanish residency — which a study-purpose stay does not confer.
complementary_credits_required: RUCT (for the TITLE): 0 (RUCT) — Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0 for 4316093. UV "Acceso y admisión" page (for the APPLICANT): no complementos are imposed; the page states only a recommended entry profile — "titulados/as ... con competencias básicas en matemáticas (álgebra y cálculo) y estadística (probabilidad)", with the most suitable profiles being "Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería Electrónica, Ingeniería de Telecomunicación e Ingeniería (en cualquiera de sus especialidades). Matemáticas, Física. Economía, Administración y Dirección de Empresas." A software engineering degree sits squarely inside the named preferred profile.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND for 2027-28. Published UV calendar for curso 2026-27 (three phases, one application per phase): FASE 1 — solicitudes 30 March to 21 April 2026 23:59, evaluation 6-11 May, results 15 May (postponed to 18 May), prematrícula 19-20 May with a NON-REFUNDABLE 300 EUR prematrícula receipt payable by 5 June 23:59, matrícula 13-16 July 2026. FASE 2 — solicitudes 25 May to 16 June 2026 14:00, results 10 July, matrícula 13-16 July 2026. FASE EXTRAORDINARIA — 22-31 July and 24 August to 2 September 2026, degree obtainable up to 18 September 2026. These are 2026-27 dates, marked as such; the 2027-28 calendar is not yet published and no date has been shifted forward.
notes: Two things a reader must not misread. (1) The UV site carries a "Plan a extinguir" page for this master — I checked it: it is the OLD internal plan, código titulación 2221, plazas "------". The live plan is código titulación 2262 with 25 plazas and identical 90-ECTS structure. The title is NOT being wound down; RUCT agrees (RENOVADA, accreditation renewed 26/03/2026). (2) Non-EEES degree holders must first obtain a resolución de equivalencia from UV, at a fee of 155,22 EUR, and UV states the equivalence resolution must be obtained for the preinscripción application to be evaluated at all — a hard gating step for this candidate that must start well before Fase 1. RUCT code confirmed by exact university+title match in the register; UV's ficha prints an internal "código titulación" (2262), not the RUCT code.
